QUOTE: "Shared by: every `this.batchRecords(...)` call in the handlers (for example `post.ts`, `thread.ts`, `group.ts`, `properties.ts`, `user.ts`, and the three product mixins)." and "`ServerDataOperatorBase` ... extends `BaseDataOperator`"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says handlers call the inherited `BaseDataOperator.batchRecords`, but it never says each mixin is constrained to extend ServerDataOperatorBase. It also says some writes bypass `batchRecords`, which contradicts "every handler's writes".
